source.quote: 6 m min -1 is recommended for horizontal facilities (flat storages or silos with diameter greater than the height)

notes: 52 640 / 60 / 6 = 146 м²; площа днища 379 м². Symaga HA — 18 % (rec_d0d7fe5e) ≈ 68 м² → 12,9 м/хв.
